title: Randomized-base GT transfer, lazy-descent STNFS core (recover-Q 9332a74d) with box-shared norm bounds, sub-bin yields, re-searched lazy plan, shared Krylov entry overhead, one-SE descent input and complete-orbit unit duplicates: 123.257090681361269

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md returns the canonical scalar x for uniform T=[x]P0 (infinity included) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). It maps T to z=e(T,Q0) against a freshly randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b (exactly the uniform nonidentity-base, independent-target distribution), converts both into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns ba mod r after checking [ba]P0=T. The core is that of recover-Q 9332a74d: excess 1.1, theta=2330/8000 sub-region of a 164,000-draw pool (retained relations >= 2^63.6617, 2.00 pool SE above 1.1 U), 99.9% ECM, X2=2^64, slacks (295, 226), band strip, f-first early abort, certified norm bounds shared by aligned 2 x 2 x 4 boxes of rows, allowance 1.0174: collection <= 2^119.669318937 units; Markowitz merge to weight 300, N=2^58.9429, eight owners, Block Wiedemann (28, 5) with five-vector Krylov passes at 12.9 instructions per vector-entry (block selection and sign paid once per +-1 entry): linear algebra <= 2^117.279842877, generator <= 2^107.806519571; 62-node lazy descent with sub-bin yields (24 node / 10 boot sub-cells, capped at 4x / 1.5x the sextile yield), the re-searched plan and boot (215, 328, 16, 4), UDUP 0.65 supported by complete unit orbits against the charged yield, lazy cofactorisation and lazy boot (at most 18 relations), and the descent relation input 2^63.624, one relative pool SE below the retained-count estimate: expected two-log work <= 2^112.3122, meter 2^113.028, Markov abort <= 0.6088324, boot failure <= 5.004e-06 per log, node counter 2^27.3 (abort <= 2^-11.75), repeats <= 2^-10.70, 2/r charged; upper-rounded core ledger rows sum to 2^119.93372061228 <= 2^119.9337206123 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, sampling, verification and output, is at most 10 x (1001/1000) x 2^119.9337206123 + 2^80/2000 < 2^123.257090681361269 G1 reference units (C=2,000). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit. {}: code identity, parameters, recorded full-run certificate, integration probes, lazy bound vs a simulation, core ledger and success, G1 conversion (80-digit) and base-randomisation bijections. {"descent": true} also re-evaluates the descent recurrence, node counter and success. evidence16.py (local, about 200 s natively, not a hosted experiment) reruns every certificate and check.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) at relation excess 1.1 (default; optional 'excess') to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional. Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
